title: Migrate to v1.3
content_data:
As you start to migrate, please read this doc carefully to ensure a smooth transition. # Checklist Here is a checklist to help you quickly get started with the migration process: 1. Go through [V1.3 updates](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1740579480076290) to get a comprehensive overview of the changes between the two versions. 2. Check out the v1.2 vs v1.3 comparison table for each endpoint in the [API reference](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1735713875563521) chapter to see the detailed changes. 3. If your endpoint has **breaking changes** in v1.3, then you might need to change your code. Otherwise your integration might break. # Changes Changes to endpoints can be split into two broad categories: breaking and non-breaking. ## Breaking Changes Breaking changes usually require you to revise your code to maintain existing functionality of your application. Example of breaking changes include: - Removing an existing endpoint - Removing any response parameter - Removing any request parameter - Addition of a new request parameter (either required or conditional) - Changing the name or data type of an existing parameter in the request or response - URL updates ## Non-breaking Changes Non-breaking changes usually require no coding work from your end, and you can adapt to them at your own discretion and pace without disruption to existing functionality. Examples of non-breaking changes include: - Addition of a new endpoint - Addition of a new request parameter (optional) - Addition of a new response parameter - More detailed error messages # Notes - As a common best practice, our v1.3 APIs do not support request parameters in GET requests. Please do not put parameters into request bodies to avoid failures or unexpected behaviors. - Make sure your endpoint URL ends with `/`. Otherwise, some unexpected errors might occur. Example:
**Correct** : https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/campaign/get/
**Incorrect** : https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/campaign/get
